With a 77% chance of rain, each outdoor main is now an indoor outing: Total Tot Time at W.D. Hill Rec Center (early-nap), the NC Museum of Art (late-nap) and Old Farm Road Park plus Mini Makers (short-nap). The moved outings were swapped into the alternatives where they fit. The plan before is under each change.

The plan before it changed

Wander the garden paths and find the Discovery Garden

Was

🌷 Sarah P. Duke Gardens

420 Anderson St, Durham, NC 27708 · Durham

Arrive 9 am, leave by 11 am · Free · Outdoors

Your toddler can wander the garden paths and find the Charlotte Brody Discovery Garden, stopping wherever something catches their eye.

  • Come early. Parking is paid and often fills before 10 am.
  • Bring a snack for a bench break halfway through.
  • Give a two-minute warning, then walk back by a different path.

About Sarah P. Duke Gardens

  • 🎨 Member Monday: Ancient Nubia

    NC Museum of Art · Raleigh · 10 am–11:20 am

    Map · Museum and park admission is free · Sign-up not listed

    Drop in to Member Monday: Ancient Nubia at the NC Museum of Art and let your toddler look at what catches their eye. Come and go whenever you like.

  • 🌳 Pullen Park Amusements

    Raleigh · 10 am–11:20 am

    Map · Free to get in; rides $2 a ticket

    Ride the carousel and the train, then run off extra energy on the playground. It opens at 10 am, so there is no waiting.

    • Let your toddler pick the first ride.
    • Snack on a bench before the last ride so leaving goes smoothly.

    Map · Free · No sign-up needed
